environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 in private subnet, fronted by ALB in public subnet. AWS WAF WebACL attached to ALB ARN with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT only; (2) Priority 1: Custom rule group 'corp-audit-log-injection-guard' with single rule using RegexPatternSet matching body/querystring for patterns containing unescaped single quotes adjacent to SQL keywords (INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|UNION|SELECT) within the same field value, action BLOCK; (3) Priority 2: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with NO action overrides (all rules in default BLOCK mode), which uses libinjection-based SQL injection detection on all query string parameters, body, and URI path. WAF logging enabled to CloudWatch Logs with sampled requests visible in console. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.waf_rule_priority_1: custom:corp-audit-log-injection-guard (regex: single-quote + SQL keyword adjacency, BLOCK)
config.waf_rule_priority_2: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet (default BLOCK, no overrides, libinjection-based detection on query_string|body|uri_path)
